objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed policy or guideline document handled from creation through release, distribution, revision, archiving, and reactivation.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Default name includes document type abbreviation, consecutive number, and title.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Document workflow or lifecycle status such as editing, released, or out of force.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which a released document is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date calculated from valid from and the period of extended validity.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Registered author assigned in document properties.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Additional person with change rights assigned in document properties.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Classification selected when creating a document and used for templates, abbreviations, validity periods, and archive durations.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation used in the default document name.

attributes.name: validity_period
attributes.description: Period after which extended validity must be checked.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period after which archived documents are physically deleted.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selected when creating a new document.

objs.name: document_version
objs.description: Version of a document created through release, revision, changes, or reactivation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status of the version in the document lifecycle.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of the document version.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and released or published directly through properties.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled dependent document released with the main document and subject to its own versioning.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person participating as reader, author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, initiator, or acknowledgement recipient.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group assigned for authorizations, distribution, archive access, or role-based selection lists.

objs.name: authorization
objs.description: Read or change right assigned to users or user groups for a document and dependent objects.

objs.name: release_workflow
objs.description: Workflow-supported approval process for a document using creator, review, and release steps.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants for release, review, validity extension, override, reactivation, or acknowledgement.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete release workflow tasks.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for a document that can be created and managed without affecting the document content or version history until scheduled.

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document before validity expires and processed with workflow support.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: Request created to invalidate a released document and archive it.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: Request created to re-validate an invalidated document.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of users and user groups maintained for a document for e-mail distribution or acknowledgement.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation requested from distribution recipients for a released document version.

objs.name: translation
objs.description: Language-dependent translated version of released document content checked and released with workflow support.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which a document can be specified as visible or not visible.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in DHC VISION by attaching a new information object and selecting a document type.

evts.name: select_template
evts.description: Select a document template when creating a new document object.

evts.name: maintain_property
evts.description: Maintain standardized or customer-specific document metadata and properties.

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: Edit the content of a document with the editing client and local Office component.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save the document after editing.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert the saved document to PDF.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group-related or person-related authorizations in document properties.

evts.name: assign_participant
evts.description: Assign author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, or translation participants in document properties.

evts.name: add_additional_information
evts.description: Add additional information to a document.

evts.name: publish_additional_information
evts.description: Release and publish additional information directly via switches in properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_information
evts.description: Delete additional information directly.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Add a controlled attachment to a document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an attachment, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark or archive an attachment with the release of the next main document version.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: Start the three-step release process for a document.

evts.name: sign_creation
evts.description: Registered author signs the creator workflow step.

evts.name: complete_review
evts.description: Assigned reviewers complete the review task positively.

evts.name: complete_release
evts.description: Assigned releaser completes the release task positively.

evts.name: reject_workflow
evts.description: A participant rejects during review or release, canceling subsequent workflow participants.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Finally release the document after successful release workflow completion.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish the document after release so addressed readers can see it.

evts.name: create_version
evts.description: Create a new document version when a released document is revised, relevant attributes or attachments change, proposals are scheduled, or reactivation is confirmed.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a change proposal for a document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a change proposal for implementation, creating a new document version.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Document the editing of assigned change proposals in the change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete a change proposal so it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: System creates a request for validity extension 30 days before document validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity and update the document valid until date.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension
evts.description: Automatically terminate the validity extension process and delete the request after a new version is released or override is declared.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Create a request for override for a document.

evts.name: start_override_workflow
evts.description: Automatically start workflow for processing an override request.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: Declare the document out of force, archive it, and revoke rights except for the archive group.

evts.name: delete_edited_version
evts.description: Delete existing edited versions after out-of-force declaration.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete archived documents after archive period expires.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation and select the document for reactivation.

evts.name: start_reactivation_workflow
evts.description: Automatically start the reactivation workflow.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Confirm reactivation, creating a new document version and restoring authorizations and attachments.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Maintain users and user groups for document distribution.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Inform assigned users and users of assigned user groups by e-mail when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request acknowledgement by e-mail upon release for maintained recipients.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirms acknowledgement through a workflow-supported task without signature.

evts.name: notify_acknowledgement_completion
evts.description: Notify author team when all maintained persons have confirmed acknowledgement.

evts.name: create_translation
evts.description: Translate released content into another language.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Check and release the translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: set_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible or not visible.

o2o.description: A document has a selected document type.
One or more document templates can be defined for each document type.
A document can be created from a selected template.
A document is managed in versions.
Additional information can be added to a document.
Attachments can be added to and released with a document.
Users can be assigned as author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, reader, initiator, or recipient for a document.
User groups can be assigned to a document for readers, roles, archive access, or distribution.
Authorizations are assigned specifically to documents.
Authorizations can be assigned at person level.
Authorizations can be assigned at user group level.
A document can be processed through a release workflow.
A release workflow consists of workflow tasks.
Workflow tasks are assigned to users.
Workflow participants complete release tasks with electronic signatures.
A change proposal belongs to a document and is displayed in it.
A validity extension request is linked to the document to be checked.
An override request is created for a selected document.
A reactivation request selects the corresponding document for reactivation.
Distribution lists can be maintained for each document.
Persons can be assigned to the distribution list.
User groups can be assigned to the distribution list.
Acknowledgements are requested and documented for a document version.
Assigned persons and users of assigned groups confirm acknowledgement.
Released documents can have language-dependent translated versions.
Participants for checking and releasing translation are assigned in document properties.
A document can be specified as visible or not visible in clients.
